request: 配置 OS 任务，3 个周期任务：1ms、10ms、100ms
config:
```yaml
Os:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
    use_get_service: true
  OsTask:
    - id: 0
      name: Task_1ms
      priority: 10
      period_ms: 1
      autostart: true
      stack_size: 512
    - id: 1
      name: Task_10ms
      priority: 5
      period_ms: 10
      autostart: true
      stack_size: 1024
    - id: 2
      name: Task_100ms
      priority: 1
      period_ms: 100
      autostart: true
      stack_size: 2048
```

request: 配置 OS 报警，用于延迟执行
config:
```yaml
Os:
  OsAlarm:
    - id: 0
      name: Alarm_DelayTask
      trigger_task: Task_Delayed
      alarm_time_ms: 50
      cycle_time_ms: 0
    - id: 1
      name: Alarm_PeriodicTask
      trigger_task: Task_Periodic
      alarm_time_ms: 100
      cycle_time_ms: 100
```
